name: cmsis-developer-assistant
description: Enable AI coding agents to manage and extend CMSIS projects, with a set of AI skills and MCP server to interface to build and debug.

cmsis-developer-assistant.timeoutInSecon.description: Timeout in seconds for debugging operations

cmsis-developer-assistant.serverPort.description: Port number for the CMSIS Developer Assistant server

cmsis-developer-assistant.installedSkill.markdownDescription: The AI Skills Pack skills — the Open-CMSIS-Pack [cmsis-skills](https://github.com/Open-CMSIS-Pack/cmsis-skills) skills and their per-category entry points `cmsis-project`, `cmsis-bring-up`, `cmsis-pack` — to copy into your personal skills directories: `~/.agents/skills` always, `~/.claude/skills` when Claude Code is installed, `$COPILOT_HOME/skills` when that variable is set. Pick them with **CMSIS Developer Assistant: Select Agent Skills**. An entry point gives the agent one slash command for the whole category; skills a selected skill depends on are installed too, hidden from the slash menu. The extension's own `cmsis-debug-live` and `cmsis-help` are always installed and need not be listed. Deselected skills that this extension installed are removed; skills you installed yourself are never touched. Has no effect while `#cmsis-developer-assistant.aiSkills.enabled#` is off.

cmsis-developer-assistant.aiSkills.enabl.markdownDescription: Enable the AI Skills Pack for selected agents: the Open-CMSIS-Pack [cmsis-skills](https://github.com/Open-CMSIS-Pack/cmsis-skills) skills and their per-category entry points (`cmsis-project`, `cmsis-bring-up`, `cmsis-pack`). When disabled, the pack skills this extension installed are removed from your skills directories (skills you installed yourself are never touched), the skills step of the setup is skipped and no install prompt is shown; the extension's own skills (`cmsis-debug-live`, `cmsis-help`) stay installed and your `#cmsis-developer-assistant.installedSkills#` selection is kept for re-enabling.

cmsis-developer-assistant.aiSkills.promp.markdownDescription: Prompt to install the CMSIS AI Skills for selected agents — the agents that have the CMSIS Developer Assistant MCP server registered — at most once a month, until you add a skill from the pack. *Don't ask again* in the prompt turns this off.

cmsis-developer-assistant.redactSecrets.markdownDescription: Withhold variable and expression values whose name or content looks like a credential (API key, token, password, connection string) before they are sent to an AI agent. Numeric scalars are never withheld, so firmware flags and counters named `auth`, `token` or `key` stay readable. Raw target reads — `read_memory`, `read_core_registers`, `read_peripheral_register`, `get_fault_info`, and `-exec` GDB passthrough — are never redacted.

cmsis-developer-assistant.dapRequestTime.description: Per-request timeout (in milliseconds) for DAP traffic to the debug adapter / hardware probe. If the probe or GDB server stalls, requests will fail with a HardwareTimeoutError instead of hanging the MCP tool call. Increase for slow targets or large memory reads.

cmsis-developer-assistant.memoryReadTime.description: Overall timeout (in milliseconds) for a single read_memory / read_core_registers tool call. Caps the total time spent talking to the hardware, even across many word-level fallback reads.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.test:transport: npm run compile && node test/transport/session-lifecycle.js && node test/transport/two-window-routing.js
